sources.title: Kazakhstan Government Resolution No. 381: original airport renaming text (2017)

license.note: No open redistribution license established. Publisher rights retained; only a link and independently written factual annotations are included, not source prose, images or tables.

sources.note: Original official newspaper reproduction, second resolution on page 1. Adopted 2017-06-20; renames the airport itself from Международный аэропорт Астана to Международный аэропорт Нурсултан Назарбаев. Clause 2 makes first official publication the effective day. names.note: Canonical Russian official airport name in the original 2017 decision. Continuity from the 2006 observation to the renaming is a reviewed inference. Original naming date remains unknown; dates before 2006-11-21 are uncertain. June 21 is the first-publication effective day; whole-day resolution remains conservative because no midnight instant is established. City renames and IATA code changes do not create name intervals.

names.name: Международный аэропорт Нурсултан Назарбаев
names.note: Canonical Russian official airport name from the original renaming, with later aviation-administration use and the fixed current-directory label corroborating continuation. The whole interval is a reviewed continuity inference, not direct evidence for every day. Known effective day is 2017-06-21, not signing day 2017-06-20 or the 2020 IATA code change. The 2020 corporate wording amendment, city renames and English translations are not additional airport renames. On or after the fixed 2026-10-25 evidence horizon the result is uncertain.
